alternate_names: Purnea Panch Mukhi Shiv Hanuman Mandir

history.summary: CSV row 151 ('Hanuman Mandir') is a generic name; identified as the prominent Panchmukhi Hanuman Mandir at Forbesganj Chowk, Line Bazar, PWD Colony, Purnia (Justdial, 800+ ratings), described by visitors as one of the most visited temples in the city. The temple's own official page styles it 'Purnea Panch Mukhi Shiv Hanuman Mandir'. Opening hours conflict: Justdial lists 'Open 24 Hrs' while the official page lists 6 AM-1 PM and 3-9 PM (verify). A YouTube video title claims the temple is 600 years old; no corroborating source was found, so antiquity is unverified. Note: a second, much smaller 'Panchmukhi Hanuman Mandir' listing exists at Rambagh, Purnia; this file documents the Forbesganj Chowk/PWD Colony one (geocoder POI match).

name: Panchmukhi Hanuman Mandir
town_description: Purnia (also Purnea) is a city in northeastern Bihar and the headquarters of Purnia district and division. An educational and commercial hub of the Seemanchal-Kosi region, it is nicknamed 'Mini Darjeeling' and takes its name from goddess Puran Devi (Puran Aranya).

travel.airport: Nearest commercial airport: Bagdogra (IXB), about 160-170 km by road; Purnia's own airport is under development.
travel.railway: Purnea Junction, a major railhead on the Katihar-Samastipur section, lies within the city.
travel.road: NH 27 and NH 31 pass through Purnia; well connected by bus, auto-rickshaw and taxi.

visitor_information.opening_hours: Official page: 6:00 AM-1:00 PM and 3:00-9:00 PM daily; Justdial lists 24 hrs (conflict - verify).
